title: GeoNest: Learning to Select Failure-Aware Neighborhoods for the Irregular Knapsack Problem in a Circular Container
abstract: arXiv:2609.38863v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The two-dimensional irregular knapsack problem in a fixed circular container is an important combinatorial optimization problem for maximizing material utilization in manufacturing. Conventional geometric packing solvers can produce tightly packed layouts, yet they often partition the residual space into isolated small pockets that cannot fit valuable unplaced polygons. To overcome this late-stage packing bottleneck, we propose a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework named GeoNest, driven by a graph policy trained via reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first construct neighborhoods by pairing failed target polygons with residual pockets. We then use explanatory poses to identify the placed polygons that block candidate insertions. These diagnosed blocking relations define bounded, fixed-item repair subproblems for the underlying geometric solver. Finally, the graph policy selects the most promising subproblem for exec

translated_title: GeoNest：为圆形容器中的不规则背包问题学习选择故障感知的邻域
translated_abstract: 在固定圆形容器中的二维不规则背包问题是制造业中最大化材料利用率的一个重要组合优化问题。传统几何排样求解器能够产生紧密排列的布局，但它们往往将剩余空间分割成孤立的小口袋，无法容纳有价值的未放置多边形。为了克服这一后期排样瓶颈，我们提出了一个名为GeoNest的故障感知大邻域搜索框架，该框架由通过强化学习训练的图策略驱动。具体而言，我们首先通过将失败的目标多边形与剩余口袋配对来构建邻域；然后使用解释性姿态识别那些阻碍候选插入的已放置多边形；这些诊断出的阻塞关系为底层几何求解器定义了有界的、固定物品的修复子问题；最后，图策略选择最有希望的子问题来执行（摘要截断）。
tldr: 提出GeoNest框架，通过强化学习训练的图策略选择故障感知的大邻域搜索子问题，诊断并修复排样后期的空间碎片化阻塞，从而提升圆形容器不规则背包问题的材料利用率。
en_tdlr: GeoNest introduces a failure-aware large neighborhood search framework driven by a reinforcement learning graph policy that diagnoses blocking relations in packing failures to overcome late-stage fragmentation bottlenecks in the irregular knapsack problem.
